C-65.Name: Wide tables, part 1: column widths remembered per file in the Mark profile, the diagram corner pill on tables, and a visible «more columns» edge
C-65.Summary: User review 2026-10-18 (brainstorm ~/prj/mark-media/ideas/view-modes.md): wide tables silently disappear past the column edge (macOS hides the scrollbar, the expand glyph shows only on hover and looks unlike the diagram pill), and resized column widths are lost on restart. Decisions: widths persist in the Mark profile (option 2) only after a real resize, keyed by file path, never written into the Markdown; tables reuse the C-56 corner pill; the scroll edge gets a visible cue. View modes «Document» / «Notebook» are a separate later change.

Problem.Description: C-39 T-002 keeps column widths in a session-only map (lib/tableResize), so they reset on relaunch. Tables carry the standalone button.ag-block-expand glyph (C-51) while diagrams moved to the hover pill (C-56 T-005/T-007). The C-39 edge shadow is faint and there is no textual cue that columns are hidden; users read a clipped table as the whole table.

Goals.R-1: Persist column widths per file in the Mark profile (prefs/userData), written only after a user resize. Key: absolute file path + table ordinal + header signature (column count and header text hash). A changed header signature drops that table's widths; a missing or moved file never receives widths; entries for files that no longer exist are pruned (on load, bounded store size). Markdown, history and isSaved are never touched.
Goals.R-2: Rename through Mark (title-bar card › Rename… / RESPONSE_FOR_RENAME and the sidebar rename) moves the stored widths to the new path; a Finder move does not.
Goals.R-3: Double-click on a column border (existing reset gesture) also removes the stored width for that column; resetTable removes the table entry.
Goals.R-4: Tables use the C-56 corner pill (renderBlockToolbar) instead of the standalone expand glyph: same look, hover-only reveal, right-edge anchor, label on button hover, one action «Open full screen» kept need-gated by expandNeed; keyboard and focus-restore behaviour unchanged.
Goals.R-5: A wide table shows a visible edge cue while columns are hidden: a stronger edge shadow plus a small «N more columns →» chip at the right edge (localized, ten locales) that scrolls the table one viewport right on click; the cue disappears when the last column is in view.
Goals.R-6: Tests: unit (width store keying, signature drop, prune, rename move, reset paths; pill on table figures; edge cue counts), e2e chromium + webkit-tables (resize → relaunch-equivalent reload keeps widths; edited header drops them; pill opens the viewer; cue click scrolls). grace lint 0; graph M-012 and verification V-M-012 updated.

Constraints.Item: No Markdown mutation, no front-matter keys, no comments written into files.
Profile storage through the existing prefs/userData IPC; App Store sandbox-safe (no new entitlements).
Every GRACE-governed edit ships MODULE_CONTRACT/MAP/CHANGE_SUMMARY; grace lint --assertions current = 0.

NonGoals.Item: View modes «Document» / «Notebook» and table breakout past the column (later change).
Pinning widths into the Markdown file.

AffectedAreas.Item: src/renderer/src/components/editorWithTabs/editor.vue (width store wiring), src/renderer/src/store/editor.js (rename hook), a new renderer util for the width store

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-1..R-6 done; npx vitest run green; table e2e green on chromium + webkit-tables; grace lint 0.
Live check (user): resize columns, quit, reopen — widths kept; move the file in Finder — widths gone; wide table shows the cue and the same pill as diagrams.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Stored-width round trip across a reload; signature-drop and rename-move unit pins; pill and cue screenshots in Paper and Ink.
